ModuleDescription: Face tracking from a recording, a video file, a webcam (MediaPipe, optionally a Babble model you have) or the Babble app, with recording of everything it sends.
UsageInstructions: Settings: %LocalAppData%\RiryTools\FTRecorder\module-config.json (written on first start; changes apply while running). source: playback, video, webcam or babbleOsc. record: true writes recordings to recordingsFolder. Video and webcam need ffmpeg (ffmpegPath). The companion app records VRCFaceTracking's output and VRChat's visemes, and turns videos into recordings.
